source.title: Challenger Gragas top guide by Bomba Guy

general: Gragas is very weak in the first levels (low damage, expensive mana, long cooldowns), so farm with W for its extra range, damage reduction and cheap passive procs, and only use Q to poke when it also last-hits a minion. Once he is strong, usually after the first recall or at level 6, and with a few points in Q, push hard and play aggressively, testing limits to draw enemies to you; Phase Rush lets you escape most ganks. Teleport back to lane if your own wave is slow pushing toward the enemy, but walk if the enemy wave is coming to you, and otherwise hold it for early team fights. Use Flash in all-ins (e.g. E plus Flash) so the opponent can't react. Around 15 minutes switch to Oracle Lens and control wards, group for fights and catch people with E-R-Flash, or split the side lane mirroring the next objective and Teleport into the fight.
